scenario.title: BATTLE OF SESENA - 29 OCT 1936
intro.text:
BATTLE OF SESENA - 29 OCT 1936

South of Madrid, Spain

Comrade, here is your order - Move west with your armored forces and occupy the towns of Esquivias and Illescas! Support this move with your air force. Your infantry occupied Sesena and defend the town against enemy attacks. Good luck!

ORDERS
After 8 turns control 3/2/1 VH for a BV/V/TV.
header.act: ACT I — LESSONS BEFORE THE GREAT WAR
player.speaker: Commander
line.scene-0.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.scene-0.text: The tank crews have painted over every marking, but the unfamiliar silhouettes of our T-26s still mark them as something Franco's men have never faced before. Spanish infantrymen watch the engines turn over and ask the interpreters whether armour can really decide the day before nightfall.
line.scene-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.scene-1.text: The Republican captain beside the lead company has seen the tanks only in newspapers. He has put his best infantry on their running boards because nobody told him how quickly armour can leave men behind.
line.decision.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.decision.text: This is our first live test of a force built around tanks, aircraft, and radio. We can drive hard for the western towns, or keep the arms close enough that a local success does not leave Seseña exposed. Which lesson do we intend to learn?
Concentrate the tanks and aircraft on a fast thrust toward Illescas.
Requisition an experienced eight-strength BT-5 detachment for the armoured thrust; its deployment costs 70 prestige.
line.decision.choice.balanced-advance.te: Advance by bounds, keeping infantry and artillery tied to the armoured column.
line.decision.choice.balanced-advance.hi: Attach an experienced eight-strength 76.2 mm battery and give every infantry formation 10 experience.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-a-0.text: Then speed is the protection. The leading companies will bypass resistance that cannot threaten the road and leave marked targets for the aircraft.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.choice-a-1.text: The Spanish captain is taking his men off the running boards. He asks whether the tanks intend to come back for them. I have no honest answer yet.
line.choice-a-2.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-a-2.text: Give him one: the Seseña road remains open until the infantry is through. Speed may choose our direction; it does not cancel our rear.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-b-0.text: Then no arm outruns the others. The tanks will take the towns, but every captured road must remain usable by the infantry and guns behind them.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-b-1.text: You have tied the tanks to marching pace on their first day. If the infantry stops at the first gun, I will remind you that this caution was chosen, not imposed.
line.post-0.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.post-0.text: The interpreter is waiting by the lead tank. I will give him the road order; the Spanish captain can decide whether it sounds like an answer.
